title: A finite projective module modulo an ideal lifts after an etale ring extension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma refines the idempotent lifting of the same section to finite projective modules: a finite projective module modulo an ideal is the reduction of a finite projective module after passing to an etale extension that is an isomorphism modulo the ideal. The proof is a 37-line construction that writes the given projective module as a direct summand of a free module, lifts the projectors to a matrix, forms the characteristic polynomial of that matrix and the resulting finite ring extension, shows that the roots x and 1 - x of that polynomial are sufficiently coprime modulo the ideal so that a canonical element becomes an idempotent of the quotient, lifts that idempotent along an etale extension using the idempotent lifting of the section, and finally takes the image of the lifted idempotent to define the projective module. The two steps with real content are the production of the idempotent of the quotient through the characteristic polynomial and the appeal to idempotent lifting, and both are displayed.
